{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./pi_monte_carlo.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   -n 8     -> -n 8
#   -t 30    -> -t 30m  (Slurm uses minutes when no HH:MM:SS is given)
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 8 -t 30m --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm -J pi_monte_carlo not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.

  # NOTE: Slurm -o/-e not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: stdout/stderr handling follows Flux defaults unless configured at submission.

  # NOTE: Slurm -p test not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible resources; you are not forcing the test partition.

  # NOTE: Slurm --mem-per-cpu=4000 not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a per-core memory reservation/limit, the job may contend for memory or be OOM-killed, affecting reliability/performance.

  module load intel/24.0.1-fasrc01 openmpi/5.0.2-fasrc01

  # Slurm used: srun -n $SLURM_NTASKS --mpi=pmix ...
  flux run -n 8 ./pi_monte_carlo.x
fi
"
}
